title.zh: Aave Schedules Vote on Babylon Native Bitcoin Collateral for V4
title.en: Aave Schedules Vote on Babylon Native Bitcoin Collateral for V4

current_state.zh: Aave has scheduled a governance vote on adding Babylon-based native Bitcoin as collateral for V4, with risk provider LlamaRisk proposing a 300 BTC cap and a further onchain vote still required before the market can go live.
current_state.en: Aave has scheduled a governance vote on adding Babylon-based native Bitcoin as collateral for V4, with risk provider LlamaRisk proposing a 300 BTC cap and a further onchain vote still required before the market can go live.
